findings.finding: 15-minute scheduler had contents:write and actions:write, dispatched any workflow file passing an existence-only check, and pushed queue changes to main.

Hourly Gumroad sync read customer emails, SHA-256 hashed selected addresses and committed hashes to public web/subscribers.json. Hashes are pseudonymous, not anonymized; prior history is not fully audited.
Manual merge queue could select all open PRs with mode=all, max_prs=0 and dry_run=false, update branches, merge PRs and delete branches.
Manual Databricks exporter queried workspace.barrot.brain and published timestamp/topic/insight/session records to public JSON and Markdown files.
Scheduled batch resolver could comment on and close matching open issues.
Hourly resolver could create issues and assign unassigned issues and PRs.
Scheduled workflow could publish a public GitHub issue containing the unvalidated legacy XRP accuracy claim.
Scheduled gap detector could create and label GitHub issues.

proposed_controls: Make the six scheduled/public issue and subscriber workflows inert with workflow_dispatch-only, permissions: {}, and if: false.
Disable Scheduler Tick and Merge Queue pending reviewed allowlists, protected per-item authorization and safe state storage.
Disable the Databricks public exporter and replace its script with a no-network, no-credential, no-write status-only entry point.
Preserve existing brain_corpus/dump.json and brain_corpus/dump.md unchanged; classify them separately before any removal or republishing.
Add four regression tests to tests/test_v3_scripts.py, explicitly included in core CI.
limitations: Existing public brain-corpus dump files remain unchanged; this proposal stops future exports but does not remove public copies or rewrite Git history.
The current subscriber JSON was previously observed empty; historical exposure in commits, forks, caches and external copies is unresolved.
Other scheduled writers and external actions from the older PR #1610 audit remain for a separate fresh-main successor.
hover_bike_updates.yml and manual Databricks token rotation remain separate reviews.
PR #1613 separately proposes fresh-main Cross Analysis and legacy accuracy containment.
